bio.zh: 李建江，北京科技大学计算机与通信工程学院教授、博士生导师，清华大学工学博士。研究方向包括高性能计算、并行与分布式计算、云计算与大数据，以及智能超算融合应用技术。
bio.en: Jianjiang Li is a professor and doctoral supervisor at the School of Computer and Communication Engineering, University of Science and Technology Beijing (USTB), with a Ph.D. in engineering from Tsinghua University. His research covers high-performance, parallel and distributed computing, cloud computing and big data, and integrated intelligent supercomputing applications.

text.zh: 清华大学计算机系，获工学博士学位。
text.en: Ph.D. in engineering, Department of Computer Science, Tsinghua University.

text.zh: 进入北京科技大学计算机系工作。
text.en: Joined the Department of Computer Science at USTB.

text.zh: 美国天普大学访问学者；时间依据 2017 年论文作者简介。
text.en: Visiting scholar at Temple University; dates from the author biography in the 2017 transaction middleware paper.

并行计算机及编程基础

research_record.zh: 据导师公开简介，科研经历涉及国家863计划、国家重点研发计划课题及教育部科学技术研究重点项目；简介记载SCI、EI学术论文70余篇。
research_record.en: The public faculty profile reports research supported by the National 863 Program, the National Key R&D Program and key research projects of the Ministry of Education. It records more than 70 SCI/EI-indexed papers.

description.zh: 指导的研究生曾多人次获得国家奖学金、优秀学位论文等荣誉。
description.en: Graduate students he supervised have received National Scholarships and recognition for outstanding theses.

title.en: Student team achievements in Microsoft’s HPC program

description.zh: 指导的两个学生团队分别获“微软HPC（高性能计算）学者项目—学生及教师研究奖”中国赛区第4名和第5名。
description.en: Two student teams he supervised placed fourth and fifth in the China division of the Microsoft HPC Scholar Program—Student and Faculty Research Awards.
